legenda_confianca.COMPROVADO: fonte oficial lida em 2026-09-05 (pagina renderizada ou proto oficial googleapis) e trecho citado
legenda_confianca.PROTO_LOCAL: descriptor/docstring do SDK google-ads 31.3.0 namespace v25 lido por introspecao em 2026-09-05
legenda_confianca.SNAPSHOT_LOCAL: matriz local docs/growth-engine/matriz-api (consulta 2026-08-26) ou evidencia do spec creative-supply-chain (2026-09-05), nao relida nesta missao
legenda_confianca.MEDIDO_REMOTO: resposta real da Google Ads API registrada em recibo/relatorio versionado no repositorio
legenda_confianca.RESEARCH_REQUIRED: fonte oficial nao acessivel ou silenciosa; nenhuma regra derivada

entradas.trecho: v25.1 (2026-08-19), v25 (2026-07-22), v24.2 (2026-06-24), v24.1 (2026-05-13), v24 (2026-04-22). v25: 'New DemandGenMultiAssetAds are opted in by default starting with this API version' (animated images from non-animated images).
entradas.impacto: versao alvo v25; Demand Gen multi-asset nasce opted-in em automacoes de imagem — o builder precisa optar por fora explicitamente (OCC-G13).

entradas.trecho: Campaign NAO contem url_expansion_opt_out. 'repeated AssetAutomationSetting asset_automation_settings = 88' — 'Contains the opt-in/out status of each AssetAutomationType.' status: 'When a new campaign is added, the status defaults to ENABLED.' brand_guidelines_enabled: 'Immutable... Only applicable to Performance Max campaigns.' demand_gen_campaign_settings.upgraded_targeting: 'Immutable.'
entradas.impacto: o unico campo v25 para desligar a expansao de URL final e asset_automation_settings; status PAUSED tem de ser explicito em todo objeto que tenha status.

entradas.trecho: FINAL_URL_EXPANSION_TEXT_ASSET_AUTOMATION = 11 'Controls automation for text assets related to Final URL expansion. This includes automatically creating dynamic landing pages from the final URL and generating text assets from the content of those landing pages... turned ON by default for Performance Max campaigns. Enabling final URL expansion also enables text asset automation. There is no way to opt out of text asset automation and still use final URL expansion.' TEXT_ASSET_AUTOMATION = 2 'By default, advertisers are opted-in for Performance Max and opted-out for Search.' GENERATE_IMAGE_ENHANCEMENT = 7 'Opted in by default for pmax.' GENERATE_ENHANCED_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS = 6 'Opted in by default.' GENERATE_DESIGN_VERSIONS_FOR_IMAGES = 10, GENERATE_VIDEOS_FROM_OTHER_ASSETS = 12, GENERATE_ANIMATED_IMAGES_FROM_OTHER_ASSETS = 13: 'By default, advertisers are opted in for DemandGenMultiAssetAd.' AssetAutomationStatus: OPTED_IN = 2, OPTED_OUT = 3 (PROTO_LOCAL).
entradas.impacto: contrato PMax: OPTED_OUT em FINAL_URL_EXPANSION_TEXT_ASSET_AUTOMATION (ja emitido pelo builder), TEXT_ASSET_AUTOMATION, GENERATE_IMAGE_ENHANCEMENT, GENERATE_ENHANCED_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS; contrato Demand Gen: OPTED_OUT em 10/12/13.

entradas.trecho: 'By default, URL expansion is turned on for all Performance Max campaigns.' 'Beginning in v22, ... FINAL_URL_EXPANSION_TEXT_ASSET_AUTOMATION asset automation type in asset_automation_settings. For earlier versions, set Campaign.url_expansion_opt_out to true.' 'If you enable final URL expansion, that also enables text customization ... you cannot opt out of text customization if final URL expansion is active.' 'Use WEBPAGE campaign criteria to set URL expansion exclusions.' Assets criados dinamicamente: final_url_expansion_asset_view; remocao via AutomaticallyCreatedAssetRemovalService.
entradas.impacto: read-back de URL exclusiva: campaign.asset_automation_settings + final_url_expansion_asset_view vazio; exclusoes WEBPAGE sao desnecessarias quando a expansao esta OPTED_OUT (nao emitir por analogia).

entradas.trecho: 'The only supported bidding strategies for Performance Max campaigns are MaximizeConversions (with optional target CPA) and MaximizeConversionValue (with optional target ROAS).' 'Performance Max campaigns automatically enable brand guidelines on all new Performance Max ... campaigns.' Com brand guidelines: 'Exactly one BUSINESS_NAME asset' e 'At least one LOGO asset' via CampaignAsset. Exemplo: Status = CampaignStatus.Paused; 'The campaign is the only entity in the mutate request that should have its status set.' contains_eu_political_advertising = DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING no exemplo.
entradas.impacto: lances fechados; brand guidelines decisao explicita (imutavel); a frase sobre 'only entity ... status set' conflita com AssetGroup.status=PAUSED do builder — OCC-G18 (provar no validate_only).

entradas.trecho: 'In a non-retail Performance Max campaign, an AssetGroup and all AssetGroupAsset objects linking the minimum required assets to that AssetGroup must be created in the same bulk mutate request.' 'AssetGroupOperation requests must be atomic. Partial failure is not supported.' 'At least one final URL is required.' 'An asset group cannot be shared between campaigns. Each campaign requires at least one asset group.' Exemplos usam ids temporarios e status PAUSED.
entradas.impacto: criacao PMax = um unico GoogleAdsService.Mutate atomico com partial_failure=False (o que o executor ja faz).

entradas.trecho: Passos: budget; campanha com bidding; 'Create an ad group without a type'; audiences; assets e Demand Gen ads. Bidding: maximize clicks, target CPA, maximize conversions, target ROAS. Exemplos: Campaign PAUSED, AdGroup ENABLED, Ad ENABLED. 'We recommend creating all the required entities in a single API request, using the GoogleAdsService.Mutate method'. Orcamento nao compartilhado; diario >= 15x tCPA (recomendacao). Tipos: DemandGenMultiAssetAdInfo, DemandGenCarouselAdInfo, DemandGenVideoResponsiveAdInfo.
entradas.impacto: ad group sem type_ (builder ja faz); MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS suportado; os exemplos oficiais criam ad group/ad ENABLED — o VOLC cria PAUSED por regra propria (builder DG ja faz).

entradas.trecho: Obrigatorios: marketing_images, square_marketing_images, headlines, long_headline, descriptions, business name. 'All other fields and images' specifications can be found in the reference page and the Help Center article.' control_spec informa opt-in em 'generated videos or asset enhancements'.
entradas.impacto: o guia nao publica peso maximo nem dimensao recomendada (bytes_maximos=null continua); control_spec e o campo para desligar enhancements/autogen video (OCC-G12).

entradas.trecho: GoogleAdsService.Mutate 'wraps a series of individual mutate calls' e permite 'creating a complete campaign structure in a single request' com 'temporary resource names'. 'Generally, cross-account mutating is not allowed; an account cannot mutate objects that it didn't create, unless it is the manager of the client that created the object.' Links: service-mutates, best-practices, bulk-mutate, batch-processing/temporary-ids.
entradas.impacto: asset de outra conta nao atravessa (guardas _checar_resource_name ja existem); ids temporarios so no mesmo request.

entradas.trecho: 'Negative WEBPAGE criteria can be used to exclude specific URLs from final URL expansion.' 'Both positive and negative criteria can be used, except for the BRAND and KEYWORD criterion type, which can only be used as negative.' 'a campaign with no specified location or location groups defaults to including all regions.'
entradas.impacto: geo e idioma continuam obrigatorios no plano (builder emite); keyword so negativa (builder emite so negativa).

entradas.trecho: ResponsiveDisplayAdInfo: marketing_images, square_marketing_images, logo_images, square_logo_images, headlines, long_headline, descriptions, youtube_videos, business_name, main_color, accent_color, allow_flexible_color, call_to_action_text, price_prefix, promo_text, format_setting, control_spec{enable_asset_enhancements, enable_autogen_video}. DemandGenMultiAssetAdInfo: marketing_images, square_marketing_images, portrait_marketing_images, tall_portrait_marketing_images, logo_images, classic_display_images, headlines, descriptions, business_name, call_to_action_text. DemandGenCarouselAdInfo: business_name, logo_image, headline, description, call_to_action_text, carousel_cards. DemandGenVideoResponsiveAdInfo: headlines, long_headlines, descriptions, videos, logo_images, companion_banners, breadcrumb1/2, business_name, call_to_actions. AssetGroup: resource_name, id, campaign, name, final_urls ('by default, the urls are eligible for expansion unless opted out'), final_mobile_urls, path1, path2, status, primary_status, ad_strength, asset_coverage... AssetGroupAsset: asset_group, asset, field_type, status, policy_summary, source. AssetGroupSignal: audience, search_theme, local_services_id. MutateGoogleAdsRequest: customer_id, mutate_operations, partial_failure, validate_only, response_content_type. AdGroupType.DISPLAY_STANDARD=3 (nenhum valor DEMAND_GEN). AssetSetType.PAGE_FEED=2. Campaign.excluded_parent_asset_set_types: 'Asset set links with these types will not be inherited by this campaign from the upper level.' DemandGenChannelStrategy: ALL_CHANNELS=2, ALL_OWNED_AND_OPERATED_CHANNELS=3; DemandGenSelectedChannels: youtube_in_stream, youtube_in_feed, youtube_shorts, discover, gmail, display, maps. url_expansion_opt_out existe SOMENTE no namespace v21 do SDK (3 ocorrencias); v22..v25: 0.
entradas.impacto: vocabulario canonico do FIELD-CONTRACT; excluded_parent_asset_set_types=[PAGE_FEED] e o campo para impedir page feed herdado.

entradas.trecho: SDK 31.3.0 nao contem as adicoes da v25.1 (Campaign.aca_migration_date_time, AssetFieldType.TEXT_DISCLAIMER ausentes). validate_only: 'Mutates only return errors, not results.' partial_failure e ids temporarios sao mutuamente excludentes. 'A API nao oferece chave de idempotencia.'
entradas.impacto: idempotencia e reconciliacao continuam responsabilidade do ledger v10; nenhum campo v25.1 e usado por este contrato.

entradas.trecho: Display: nao existe guia oficial de criacao de campanha Display; RDA specs so no proto; peso maximo e video specs [NAO CONFIRMADO]; MANUAL_CPC compatibilidade com Display [NAO CONFIRMADO]; placement positivo contradiz duas fontes. Demand Gen: minimo diario 5 USD (equivalente local) desde 2026-04-01; logo 128 (proto) vs 144 (Help Center); Target CPC [baixa]. PMax: tabela oficial de asset requirements (HEADLINE 3-15/30, LONG_HEADLINE 1-5/90, DESCRIPTION 2-5/90 com uma <=60, MARKETING_IMAGE 1-20 1.91:1 600x314 5120KB, SQUARE 1-20 1:1 300x300, LOGO 1-5 1:1 128x128, PORTRAIT <=20 4:5 480x600, LANDSCAPE_LOGO <=20 4:1 512x128, YOUTUBE_VIDEO <=15 >=10s); brand guidelines imutavel; portfolio proibido; 100 asset groups/campanha; 10.000 negativas.
entradas.impacto: regua de CREATIVE-ASSET-REQUIREMENTS; pontos [NAO CONFIRMADO] herdados como RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

entradas.trecho: Demand Gen: quadrada 1:1 300x300/1200x1200; horizontal 1.91:1 600x314/1200x628; vertical 4:5 480x600/960x1200; 9:16 600x1067/1080x1920; .jpg/.png 'Max. file size: 5 MB'; logo 1:1 'Min. size: 144x144' 'Max. file size: 150 KB'; video 'Min. video duration: 5 seconds'.
entradas.impacto: peso e duracao Demand Gen (o proto nao os declara).

entradas.trecho: 'When brand guidelines are enabled, BUSINESS_NAME and LOGO must use CampaignAsset instead of AssetGroupAsset.' tabela identica a EV-13 PMax §4.
entradas.impacto: PMAX_FIELD_REQUIREMENTS (observabilidade_pmax/coverage.py) e a regua unica; requisitos.yaml PERFORMANCE_MAX coincide.

entradas.trecho: validate_only=True na conta-laboratorio via MCC: Display APROVADO (9 operacoes: budget, campanha DISPLAY PAUSED, geo, idioma, ad group DISPLAY_STANDARD, 3 asset_operation com bytes, ad_group_ad RDA). Primeira tentativa recusada com asset_error.DUPLICATE_ASSETS_WITH_DIFFERENT_FIELD_VALUE (mesmos bytes em dois papeis) + 3 mutate_error.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND em cascata. Demand Gen APROVADO (9 operacoes) com budget_diario=60; com 10 recusou campaign_budget_error.BUDGET_BELOW_PER_DAY_MINIMUM e details.budget_per_day_minimum_micros=25400000 BRL. PMax: ler_mensuracao leu 10 conversion_action, 0 validas (nenhuma com include_in_conversions_metric=True) e o builder recusou localmente antes da API; 27 operacoes/19.928 bytes serializados offline. Conta-laboratorio NAO e test_account (test_account=False, BRL). Zero mutate.
entradas.impacto: PROVEN_REMOTE_VALIDATE para Display e Demand Gen (payloads de 01/09); PMax nunca chegou a API; minimo diario DG e por moeda e vem da API.

entradas.trecho: Search: 28/08 mutate ACEITO (72 operacoes) e read-back campaign_status=PAUSED, ad_group ENABLED, ad ENABLED, policy REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS; 01/09 canario com ledger v10 (34 operacoes, validate_only 3x estavel, item criada_pausada, recibo sucesso, marca VOLC-CANARY-<12hex>, campanhas_com_a_marca=1, delta de campanhas na conta +1); 03/09 terceira criacao autorizada confirmada por read-back. Rollback documentado como campaign.status=REMOVED (nao executado).
entradas.impacto: unico canal PROVEN_REMOTE_CREATE_AND_READBACK; padrao de recibo/ledger/read-back a replicar; filhos ENABLED foi a doutrina Search — os novos canais nascem com TODOS os objetos PAUSED.

entradas.trecho: 'selective_optimization ... only ... on an App campaign'. 'Customer goals define the default goals for your entire account, while campaign goals override'. 'The Google Ads API doesn't support creating or removing [CustomerConversionGoal, CampaignConversionGoal, ConversionGoalCampaignConfig]'. 'By default, primary_for_goal will be true if not set' e 'include_in_conversions_metric esta deprecado em favor dele'.
entradas.impacto: conversion goal por campanha e ato separado (update-only); o portao de mensuracao PMax usa include_in_conversions_metric, campo deprecado — OCC-G15 RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

entradas.trecho: nao lido nesta missao
entradas.impacto: aceitacao de AssetGroup.status=PAUSED na criacao (OCC-G18) e teto de campanhas por conta ficam por provar.

entradas.url: peso maximo de arquivo e specs de video para ResponsiveDisplayAdInfo; compatibilidade MANUAL_CPC/TARGET_CPA avulso com DISPLAY; placement positivo em Display; defaults de GENERATE_LANDING_PAGE_PREVIEW/TEXT para PMax; se AdGroupType deve ficar UNSPECIFIED em Demand Gen (o guia diz 'sem tipo'; o enum nao tem DEMAND_GEN)
entradas.trecho: sem fonte oficial que declare
entradas.impacto: mantidos fora do contrato ou como decisao explicita do operador; nunca preenchidos por memoria.
